aPlusContent.title: Product Description
aPlusContent.rawText:
Product Description
If you are looking for a wall Mounted projector screen, then you may take a look at the Inlight Universal Wall type Projector Screen. Not only will it become the best partner of your projecting device, but will also help you a lot when it comes to a vital business presentation before your seniors. This screen will deliver bright colors and crisp pictures along with the finest details present in your PowerPoint slides. Made of premium quality fabric. The Screen comes with the spring action mechanism in which you need to hook the screen at the bottom to stop. You can stop the screen easily with the help of the nail fixed at the bottom of the wall. 
Inlight Universal Manual Wall Type Pull Down Projector Screens 
Projector Screen 
The Inlight Universal Manual Wall Type Pull Down Projector Screen is made up of imported high gain fabric that has matte finish for better picture quality. It is white in color and comes with black borders. It measures 6 Feet in Width and 4 Feet in Height, and diagonally it measures 7 Feet/84 Inches. The screen is made as such to reflect every bit of light that is falling on it, thus recreating a zoomed version of the picture that is being projected on it. It can support a picture format with 4:3 aspect ratio. 
Clear and High Definition Display 
It has an amazing display with 1080P 3D and 4K ready technology that potentially offers a much better picture quality with smoother motion, richer and more natural colors. 
Compatible With all the Projectors 
Inlight Universal Manual Wall Type Pull Down Projector Screens is Compatible with all the Projectors available in the Indian Market. 
Comes With 1.2 Gain Screen Fabric 
The screen is perfectly designed using a quality high gain screen fabric material which is white from the front and black from the back side and is most preferable and compatible. The screen diffuses visual light in all the directions evenly for a wide viewing angle relative to the screen with a similar viewing experience. 
Easy to Clean Screen Surface 
This screen is made up of synthetic water friendly high gain fabric which is easy to wash. You can use normal water for cleaning the surface of the screen.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Super Useful! Not the TOP choice, but very handy.
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: So far I’ve had this projector for a few months. I’ve found it EXTREMELY useful since we have all sorts of different rooms in my house, and we like to change locations where we chill for the evening. I use it for displaying my workouts (Ring Fit and Yoga) and occasionally gaming, and on a few circumstances as a monitor for my computer. A few things I would recommend: make sure you have the right lighting. During the daytime, I found that reducing sunlight was best when projecting on a darker painted wall. On a lighter painted wall, I was able to see the image just fine with a room that was lit with afternoon light, but not pouring with bright sunlight. White background is ideal. It also depended on the device I used and what the image contained. Animal Crossing: New Horizons, while playing in the daytime mode in the game and in a darker room, was great. Playing anytime during the nighttime mode was a little tougher to see. Some games that required you to read smaller text, like Don’t Starve, weren’t as successful because certain texts became harder to read on the projector. I’ve used all sorts of different devices via the HDMI connection (even PS2, GameCube, and Wii) and had fun briefly displaying them with success, but haven’t done full gaming experiences with them just yet. I found that overall, displaying bigger text is ideal for the projector.The HDMI connection is the best mode of connection, in my opinion. I tried the AirPlay mode once or twice and both times needed to set up the internet and haven’t done it again since then. As a portable battery and its travel size, I also like it a TON. I've used it on different kinds of tripods as well.When I rated this, I wanted to give more of a 4.5 overall because of its usefulness, its travel size, and...well, it's really cool to have a pocket projector that's the size of my iPhone. However, my standards for picture quality are not as high as others. If you buy, just be aware of what to expect. It works best under certain conditions and with certain images. My boyfriend is a photographer and video editor, so his standards for display quality are VERY high (always wanting to see movies in IMAX or 4K, looking at quality of the picture, etc.), so he would personally not use this projector as much as I do. It had its moments of imperfections, which I think generally are meant for an actual television screen, and those imperfections are forgivable for the other nifty things it's capable of. It's definitely useful in situations where you don't want to lug an entire television down the stairs or to different rooms if you want changes of scenery in the house or need to travel to a different location outside of the house and can't plug into a display of the sort wherever you end up. This purchase will definitely depend on your preferences and how much you think you will end up using the pocket projector. For how often I use it, I think I've made it worth its price.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I am writing this review in regards to my AKASO mini projector. I have utilized this product for the past 6 months or so and I absolutely love it. I purchased this projector after having many many issues with the infamous "mini white pico projector" (not sure of the brand name), which is well known in the baking community, and I do not recommend because of the many issues I have endured. However, I HIGHLY recommend this AKASO projector for all of your baking and decorating needs when it comes to needing a projector for custom desserts. Here are a few reasons why:1. The battery life is AMAZING. It lasts me HOURS before I need to re-charge it. And when the time comes to charge, it takes less than an hour to fully re-charge! AH-MAZING. I can get all of my custom decorated baked goods done confidently knowing this projector is reliable. (I honestly may even purchase a second one soon just because!)2. BLUETOOTH. I absolutely love not having to purchase extra cords and have the annoyance of entanglement on my workbench/desk. I love that I can easily connect my phone or Ipad without plugging anything in!3. The projector also comes with a remote which works great and is very useful so I don't have to keep taking my projector off the stand every time I need to turn it on/off or select something on the menu.4. Lastly this projector is very user friendly. I am not very tech-savy and the manual is very easy to understand. The projector is very easy to use. It took me less than 30 minutes to learn the device inside and out.The only reason I gave this review a 4 instead of a 5 stars is because of the image quality. I use a lot of small detailed fonts/images on my decorated cookies. The only beef I have with the projector is I wish it had a clearer image for tiny detailed images and fonts. It seems the smaller the image the more pixilated the image becomes. Other than that it is awesome, and again its nothing too serious that keeps me from executing my custom cookie orders. productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I’ve purchased several Anker charging cables over the years, feeling they are superior over the OEM cables that arrive with each new phone/tablet.  We’re a family of 6 with 4 teenage girls and the cables take a lot of abuse with the constant charging of devices.  Having lost my personal cable to one of my daughters, I decided to try one of these new USB-C cables for their fast charging capability...Out of a dozen+ cables I received, this one was slightly defective.  It would only charge if the cable was plugged in a certain orientation.  One way it would be fine, but if the cable was flipped over and reinserted, the charging indicator would flash on... then off... making constant “dinging” sounds from the device.  I contacted Anker Support who immediately sent me a replacement cable with no hesitation.  The experience was easy and the outcome satisfying.  The new cable arrived a few days later and worked flawlessly.These are solid cables, both attractive, and well built.  Never hesitate to buy from Anker because in the rare instance that something goes wrong, they are quick to make it right.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 18 May 2024
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Best type of cable for long runs.
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I was using a high quality (I thought) 30ft copper HDMI cable between my Emotiva home theater processor and television, and had a couple of problems. One was that the processor would freeze up from time to time and needed rebooting, the other was that there would be "No Signal" messages on the screen and I would have to turn everything off and turn it all back on in  a particular order to get all the handshakes to occur properly. A tech from Emotiva suggested an *optical* HDMI cable, which I had no idea existed, and probably would have overlooked them even if they had shown up in any of my searches. Further research confirmed that copper HDMI is only good for about 20ft, and then starts getting sketchy depending on how much data your sending. He had suggested a different brand but I found this one and chose it on price. It is working perfectly now without any of the issues I had been experiencing so I couldn't be happier. I think they are made well enough for my needs but sure there are others made with better materials, but that won't affect performance. As long as the data's getting through, picture and sound are perfect.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 27 August 2024
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Last year I decided to move my tower behind me and in a corner. At the time I had a heck of a time getting a HDMI cable that would send the signal more than 12 feet. After three or four attempts I found one but recently it died. When I went to order a new HDMI cable I stumbled upon these fiber cables and decided to give them a shot. I am glad I did, the cable is built solid but has a good bit of flex (don't bend a fiber cable) but the best part is the picture is clean as can be and runs 4k 100Hz not without breaking a sweat. I will only buy fiber HDMI/DP cabled from now on that's for sure.

aPlusContent.title: From the manufacturer
aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer
High Speed Ultra HDMI 2.0 Cable with Ethernet 30AWG 4K x 2K @ 60HZ 
The HDMI cable is the newest digital video connection on the market. It transfer uncompressed high-definition video and multi channel digital audio in resolutions higher than 1080p. HDMI cables are convenient because they will allow the transfer of digital audio and video in a single cable, permitting a less confusing mess of wires and a cleaner entertainment center. They are backward compatible to all previous versions. 
High Quality Picture, Sound and Ethernet all in 1 Cable 
Delivering clear, vibrant video, the C&E High-Speed HDMI Cable with Ethernet meets the latest standards, which means it considerably expands bandwidth up to 18 Gbps, offers 4K@50/60 (2160p) video resolution (four times more clarity than 1080p/60), and supports the wide-angle theatrical 21:9 video aspect ratio. 
The cable also offers dynamic synchronization of video and audio stream: it can deliver two video streams (dual view) simultaneously and up to four audio streams simultaneously. Even more, the HDMI cable supports up to 32 audio channels and up to 1536 kHz total audio. CEC extensions provide increased command of your electronic devices through a single control point. 
The versatile cable’s built-in Ethernet allows for sharing an Internet connection among multiple devices - no need for separate Ethernet cables. Enjoy HD video and digital audio combined into one cable with the Ethernet-ready High-Speed HDMI Cable from C&E. 
High-Speed HDMI Cable (Latest Version) 
With Ethernet have been designed to meet the performance standards set by HDMI 2.0 and have passed stringent Category 2 testing. They are backward compatible to all previous versions. 
Backwards Compatible with all Previous HDMI Version 
Our Cables are backwards compatible with all previous HDMI standards, the HDMI cable can be used with all HDMI devices. When you connect two devices with different HDMI standards, they will automatically find the best available connection. 
Main Features: 
CL3 Rated Shielded 30AWG Premium Grade Cable with Soft PVC Jacket Perfect for In-Wall Installations. 
24K Gold Plated with 99.99% Oxygen Free Copper Conductor (Bare Copper), 
It has an Audio Return Channel (ARC) that combines both the audio and video channel in one cable. 
Fully Shielded with 24K Golden-plated connector provides the unique quality that maintains strength 
Audio Return Channel 
The new specification adds an audio channel that will reduce the number of cables required to deliver audio 'upstream' from a TV to an A/V receiver for processing and playback. In cases where a TV features an internal content source, such as a built-in tuner or DVD player, the Audio Return Channel allows the TV to send audio data upstream to the A/V receiver via the HDMI cable, eliminating the need for an extra cable. 
4K Resolution Support 
The new specification enables HDMI devices to support extremely high HD resolutions, effectively four times the resolution of a 1080p device. Support for 4K allows the HDMI interface to transmit digital content at the same resolution as the state-of-the-art Digital Cinema systems used in many movie theaters. 
HDMI Ethernet Channel 
The HDMI 2.0 specification adds a data channel to the HDMI connection, enabling high-speed, bi-directional communication. Connected devices that include this feature can send and receive data via 100 Mb/sec Ethernet, making them instantly ready for any IP-based application. 
3D Support 
The version of the specification defines common 3D formats and resolutions for HDMI-enabled devices, enabling 3D gaming and other 3D video applications.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: My only option for decent audio on a HP Pavilion Envy with a nVidia 3070ti was using its HDMI Audio.  USB audio options would lock up Win11 do to a USB power issue with the MB, there is no expansion for internal Sound Cards and the onboard is extraordinary pathetic for a gaming PC.  Win11 kept messing up the settings with a Denon X2800H AVR and blocking a straight nVidia HDMI Denon ARC to HDMI Monitor connection at random.  So I tried this Musou 1080P HDMI Audio Extractor to Optical Toslink(SPDIF) and it is working so far with no hiccups or glitches.  The Denon saw the Optical Toslink(SPDIF) audio connection right away and sound is working very cleanly. Win11 recognizes I am connected from nVidia HDMI to a MS-HDMI-RX device.  Win11 doesn't recognize a Optical Toslink(SPDIF) connection as the nVidia HDMI is the primary connection and the Denon is just a passthrough.  This explains why it won't see a 5.1 connection on the Denon as HDMI is 2 channels, not 5.  Nevertheless, a very inexpensive workaround for my PC rig that works fine.  The Denon put the soundstage in Matrix Mode with headphones plugged in which is a ProLogic mode that turns out very good clarity and sound for voice & music.  I know there are many different reason people use this converter with hit n miss.  It was a home run hit for me

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: 32ft works with Oculus Link/Quest - For me
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I have nothing to complain about on this cable, build seems good and it worked for my purpose. I ran this 32ft cable from my USB 3.1 Gen 1 (USB 3.0) port on my motherboard to the playspace I use for my Oculus Quest using Oculus Link, also have a 10ft Anker USB 3.0 cable and a 90 degree USB C adapter. I have had no issues or stutters. I did not need to use the power port at the end of the cable to make this work. I cannot attest to the connection speed since I have not run any tests, but it has been working with Oculus Link running supersampling in the Oculus Debug Tool @ 1.2 Pixel override and 2784 pixel resolution / Curvature Low, which currently is the recommended maximum to run through the Quest. I hope this helps some people interested in this cable for this purpose.I can also confirm this cable has the extra "box" in the middle of the cable, so you would have a hard time feeding it through a smaller conduit. I have mine run above the basement drop ceiling, so no issue for me.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 16 May 2019
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: Works without issue to get an additional 30 feet for my Samsung Odyssey + VR headset. Haven't encountered any of the ear blasting static I've run into with every other cable I've tried. Only drop I've encountered at all is the time I tested it without powering the cable to see if that worked. Also be aware that I am NOT able to directly connect this to the headset from the PC. It sees the headset is connected but tells me to check my cables. For whatever reason as soon as I put a powered USB 3.0 hub (just a cheap Insignia one) between the cable and headset it all works with no issue. Perhaps the repeater bits aren't in the female end to send it another 15 feet and the hub accomplishes that? Thankfully the power connection is on the female side so it keeps the plugs for this, the hub, and the powered HDMI repeater together. So this works great for WMR but you'll probably need a powered 3.0 hub between the cable and headset. Only downside is that because of the repeater blocks in the cable (that make it work) I don't think I'll be able to nicely sleeve the USB and HDMI cables together but I'll take function over form.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 28 January 2019
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Worked for me on third Rift sensor
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I used the 10m variant of this cable to connect the rear (third) Oculus Rift sensor in my son's bedroom.  If I connect to the motherboard's 'normal' USB 3.0/USB 3.1 Gen 1 ports (the blue ones, provided by the chipset/CPU), then the sensor connects at USB 2.0 speeds.  After a bit of trial and error, I connected it to the onboard USB 3.1 Gen 2 port (provided by an Asmedia chip) and so far it is working perfectly at USB 3.0 speeds, every time.It is worth noting that on this motherboard (Asus Maximus X Hero) there are TWO Asmedia USB 3.1 Gen 2 controllers, one for the rear 2 ports and the other supplies the onboard front panel header.  I bought a back panel plate to connect to this to access the otherwise dormant second Asmedia chip.  That way the 3 sensors are each on separate USB 3 controllers without the need for an add-in card.Good cable so far.****** WORD OF WARNING - DO NOT CONNECT ANY KIND OF POWER TO THE USB-C CONNECTOR ON THE END OF THIS CABLE - DESPITE THE MANUFACTURER IMPLYING THAT YOU CAN.  THAT CONNECTOR IS NOT FOR THAT PURPOSE AT ALL.  IT IS MERELY AN ALTERNATIVE TO THE USB TYPE-A.  IF YOU CONNECT POWER TO THIS THEN YOU RISK DAMAGING YOUR PC OR PERIPHERAL ******

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I have a hard drive for movies located behind my TV because the USB lead is so short. Whenever I need to add, or delete items, I have to reach behind the big screen to unplug it from the USB port, and then (even worse) try to find the socket to plug it back in again.This 5 Metre USB 3.0 compatible USB A male - USB A female extension lead solves that problem.  I can now relocate the hard drive some distance from the TV, and easily access the USB to plug it in to my PC.The lead is very good quality, and the cable is thicker than on many leads, which should ensure a longer life. Because it is USB 3.0 it transfers data really quickly, and playback is absolutely perfect, with no degradation of picture, or sound.I am really pleased with this lead, it is a simple solution to the problem I had, and it is the perfect length too.  My only reservation is the price, which is a lot more expensive than some similar products, but the quality may well compensate for that. There is also a 24 month warranty for peace of mind. product, highly recommended.

- Supporting IR adjust VOLOME

- The use of DC 12V/1A external power adapter power supply, wide voltage can use DC (5-19V) power supply

Pros:1. Works, without audio distortions or crackling sounds2. Looks goodCons (I use it on laptop, not sure for Android/iOS. Connection: earphone to THIS converter to Laptop type C port):1. Lets say the volume for my laptop is at 20. Whenever I open a YouTube video or media file, the volume becomes very loud, like level 80 (though it is technically still at level 20). Only after you change the volume, it comes back to normal. For e.g. you will have to increase the volume from 20 to 21 and back to 20. This sort of change brings the volume back to actually feeling like 20 instead of 80. Weird quirk, I know.2. Actually not a Con, but becomes one when combined with above point. So as soon as you plug your earphone into this converter, any media file/YouTube video that was paused will start playing (and when you remove the earphone it will pause automatically). Its a smart feature, but as soon as you plug the earphone, the volume will sound very loud (as described in point 1) - you will have to make some change in the system volume to normalize it. Becomes disturbing to plug your earphone and have some video that you weren't even expecting to play blasted into your ears.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: So far so good. EDIT 2: It's working great again
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I'm using this to split the output from a Chromecast Ultra to a 4K TV and an AV receiver. My receiver is old and doesn't support 4K passthrough, so I need a direct connection from my Chromecast to my TV in order to get 4K video. But I also want the best possible sound for my home theater.So far it is working great. My TV recognizes the 4K signal from my Chromecast, and my receiver gets a 5.1 signal.I had a similar unit from another manufacturer, but it only worked for about six months. Reviews from this and other similar devices seem to indicate a very short lifespan. However, unlike my previous device, this one has an on/off switch, so I'm hoping that keeping it off when not in use will extend the life. Fingers crossed.EDIT: In using this with my Chromecast Ultra I've learned that every time I first turn everything on, the Chromecast reverts back to 1080 video. Every time I want to watch 4K video I have to go into the Chromecast settings and change the display back to 4K, then power cycle this device. So it works, but it's not ideal.EDIT 2: I discovered that the problem I was having with my Chromecast was because of the Chromecast, not the splitter. I started having Chromecast problems even when it was connected directly to my TV. I purchased an Amazon Fire Stick 4K Max and it works perfectly with the splitter.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Does NOT work with NVIDIA GPUs - checked with all the 30 Series NVIDIA cards - NONE WORKED
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This adapter doesn't seem to have a valid edid, resulting in NVIDIA drivers labeling it as Fail-safe. This restricts the monitor resolution to a safe limit, which is much lower than the monitor's capability. In my case, it was 640 x 480 pixels.So in Windows Display settings > my monitor that was connected to this Adapter was displayed as a tiny one and there was nothing listed under the Color profile. That was weird since I use a color-calibrated profileInstead of my full 1080p monitor, the Display setting in Windows only showed NV-Failsafe under Display 1.Not only that but the current resolution was set to 640 x 480 pixels and 6-bit color depth, and I could NOT change it, as it was locked and greyed out.I could NOT also change the refresh rate. Actually all configurations of the monitor connected to this DP-to-DVI were greyed-out.I reinstalled NVIDIA drivers, checked that I had the latest Drives, unplugged-replugged the Adapter multiple times, restarted the whole Computer multiple times, and nothing helped.And the same problem happened when I switched to Linux as well.So overall if you are using NVIDIA GPU, I would not recommend this adapter.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 17 June 2016
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Do not buy if you need sound on HDMI to pass through...
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: See Update Below...While it DOES extract audio to the optical out, it does not pass audio out thru the HDMI to my TV, even when PASS is selected on the 3 position slide switch.  What makes matters work, my Sony TV puts up a error message on-screen saying that the audio is not the right standard.I could live without a pass-thru I suppose, but how am I supposed to watch TV with that graphic up? No settings on the TV will fix this, so I'm forced to conclude that for me, this unit is useless.Update: ok, this product was not at fault, at least not entirely. HDMI is more than video+audio; it is also communication. When my TV, which does not accept 5.1 audio is connected to a blueray player (for example), and that player is set to output 5.1 over the HDMI, the TV must be communicating to it to say "NO. Give me 2 channel output (mixdown?) over HDMI" and it does.When the Tensun is in between, IT IS WHAT COMMUNICATES to the source machine. The selector switch must tell the source what type of audio to give it. However, if 5.1 is selected, then 5.1 continues through to the TV, without the TV's demand for 2-channels being heard. This, IMHO, is what leads to the TV's on-screen error message. Luckily, if i bring the TV volume all the way down to zero (which is fine as there is no sound from the TV at this point anyway), the error message goes away, and I am from to send 5.1 audio to my receiver via the optical output.Also, for some reason, passthrough is now working.  I have no explanation for this.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I thought this thing was great, but after about a month of use (maybe ten uses and as many hours) it started malfunctioning. The seller sent me a new one free of charge, but the audio out went out (both 9 mm and optical) on that one after a couple of weeks. I recommend getting something a little better quality.

productPageReviews.reviewTitle: Accurate fault detector for the price.
productPageReviews.reviewDescription: WARNING: ELECTRICITY IS FATAL AND CAN KILL YOU. TAKE APPROPRIATE PRECAUTION BEFORE ATTEMPTING REPAIRS ON ELECTRONIC PRODUCTS.The MX 1177 works quite well, it's a small form factor voltage detector with three pins, and it works on most standard switchboards without problems. The front has three LEDs which glow accordingly to the status of the wiring in the switchboard. I've seen some reviews that mentioned that all the LEDs glow regardless of the status of the connection, but that's not true in my case. The lights glow appropriately and I've been able to figure out that three switchboards in my house were wired incorrectly (power and neutral wires inverted). I opened the switchboards and sure enough, each of the switchboards had inverted power and neutral wires.The only problem with the unit itself is that it's a bit difficult to fit into all kinds of switchboards as the pins are spaced wider than usual (by approximately .2-.4mm) which can make some switchboards feel a bit dangerous to plug into. A little bit of fiddling and the plug will fit but please be careful as to not use too much force as the chassis of the plug or switchboard plate may get damaged.This is an easy recommend, does the job and is cheap. 4 stars because I've purchased it recently, the fifth can only be given to things that last longer than 6 months!
Worth for money

Smooth, crystal clear voice ,fantastic bass and hearing all instruments in songs and movies. Theatre experience on OTT apps like Netflix, Hotstar . Product Description
CABLESETC Digital Coaxial SPDIF Cable for MI TV, Digital Audio Cable (Gold, 5m) 
About the Brand: 
CABLESETC is a well-known name for high quality cables in the online world for over a decade. 
>>> This is our new "PRO" series cable with the best quality and stability which has been designed with our years of experience with Audio Video Cables. 
What is Digital Coaxial ? 
An S/PDIF coaxial cable can carry linear PCM or multi-channel Dolby AC-3/DTS digital content from a source device, such as CD or DVD player to an AV receiver or Surround Sound Preamp/Processor. Digital Coaxial Audio Connections use RCA-style connection plugs. 
>> This "CABLESETC" digital audio cable features proper characteristic impedance, fast frequency-independent signal propagation and effective shielding against EMI/RFI. This interconnect uses smooth, flawless, large cross-section tinned OFC as the signal conductor. 
>> A foamed PE insulation exhibits extremely low dielectric constant. It provides two layers of shielding: one OFC copper braid and one overlapped Mylar foil. The precision design and manufacturing ensures the characteristic impedance of the cable assembly remains 75 Ohms, +/- 5 Ohms. 
Precise soldering techniques using expensive solder creates increased electrical integrity, maximum signal transfer, long term reliability, and performance under the most demanding conditions. The ultra-flexible PVC jacket enables easy installation and resists bending and kinking which can cause errors in the signal path. This high performance S/PDIF digital cable is also ideal as a premium, extended length composite video cable for especially demanding video applications!

title: NEUMI Atom 4K Ultra-HD Digital Media Player for USB Drives and SD Cards - with HDMI and Analog AV, Automatic Playback and Looping Capability
breadCrumbs: Electronics > Home Audio > Media Streaming Devices > Streaming Clients
description: The NEUMI ATOM 4K is the easy and affordable way to add video, photo, and music playback to any TV, new or old, at up to 4K Ultra-HD quality. Just attach a USB drive or SD card with your media files, select a file, and play! It is simple and intuitive to use with no complicated settings or controls. Turn on its automatic playback and resume capability and you won’t even need to pick up the remote. HDMI 4K/60fps Ultra-HD Quality The ATOM 4K offers stunning video quality through its HDMI output that supports up to 2160p/60Hz resolution, with support for the latest video formats such as H.265/HEVC. It can feed digital surround sound to your home theater receiver for a cinema-like listening experience. Additionally, the ATOM 4K provides analog AV output for connecting to an older TV, or for sending audio to a stereo system. Reads USB Drives and SD Cards Simply copy your videos, photos, or music files onto a USB drive or an SD card, insert it into the ATOM 4K, and you are ready to play those files using an easy-to-navigate menu. Got a lot of media files? No problem! The ATOM 4K can read USB drives up to 4TB or Micro SD cards up to 512GB. Popular file systems are supported, including FAT32, exFAT and NTFS. Fully Automatic Playback Turn on its automatic playback feature and the ATOM 4K will find and play media files on its own without any user input. It will also remember where you stopped watching on a video and resume playing from the stop point. Combined with the ability to loop and repeat videos continuously, the ATOM 4K is a perfect player for simple digital signage. Media Format Support Video: MP4, MKV, AVI, TS/TP, MOV, VOB, and M2TS files using H.265/HEVC, H.264/AVC, VC1 or MPEG2/4 codecs, up to 4096x2304p@60fps resolution, 10-bit color, and 250mbps Photos: JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF (non-animated), PNG Music: MP3, WMA, OGG, FLAC, APE, AAC

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Tiny device does big job well!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: My collection of videos, photos and music on an external hard drive going back many CODECS (decades)would not all play on my LG smart TV. I played them plugged into an ACE PC attached to the LG after buying the ACE PC  in October 2020. Sadly, it died this month (March 2024) with no HDMI output - an apparently common fault.This little NEUMI atom 4K media player has stepped up to media player duties on my extensive mix of CODECS with aplomb. Amazingly, the ancient photos rescued from slides going back to the 1970s, videos to the 1990s,  HD and 4K recent videos have been played better than ever seen before. the SLR-based old photos look like 4K on the LG TV. The 4K videos play smoothly and impressively. Viewed on a large projector screen the HD and 4K videos are impressive.The device does get hot after a few hours; I rest it on a thick metal plate; also the easy-to-set-up anduse remote works only if pointed at a fairly narrow angle to the device.

aPlusContent.title: From the manufacturer
aPlusContent.rawText:
From the manufacturer
High Speed Ultra HDMI 2.0 Cable with Ethernet 30AWG 4K x 2K @ 60HZ 
The HDMI cable is the newest digital video connection on the market. It transfer uncompressed high-definition video and multi channel digital audio in resolutions higher than 1080p. HDMI cables are convenient because they will allow the transfer of digital audio and video in a single cable, permitting a less confusing mess of wires and a cleaner entertainment center. They are backward compatible to all previous versions. 
High Quality Picture, Sound and Ethernet all in 1 Cable 
Delivering clear, vibrant video, the C&E High-Speed HDMI Cable with Ethernet meets the latest standards, which means it considerably expands bandwidth up to 18 Gbps, offers 4K@50/60 (2160p) video resolution (four times more clarity than 1080p/60), and supports the wide-angle theatrical 21:9 video aspect ratio. 
The cable also offers dynamic synchronization of video and audio stream: it can deliver two video streams (dual view) simultaneously and up to four audio streams simultaneously. Even more, the HDMI cable supports up to 32 audio channels and up to 1536 kHz total audio. CEC extensions provide increased command of your electronic devices through a single control point. 
The versatile cable’s built-in Ethernet allows for sharing an Internet connection among multiple devices - no need for separate Ethernet cables. Enjoy HD video and digital audio combined into one cable with the Ethernet-ready High-Speed HDMI Cable from C&E. 
High-Speed HDMI Cable (Latest Version) 
With Ethernet have been designed to meet the performance standards set by HDMI 2.0 and have passed stringent Category 2 testing. They are backward compatible to all previous versions. 
Backwards Compatible with all Previous HDMI Version 
Our Cables are backwards compatible with all previous HDMI standards, the HDMI cable can be used with all HDMI devices. When you connect two devices with different HDMI standards, they will automatically find the best available connection. 
Main Features: 
CL3 Rated Shielded 30AWG Premium Grade Cable with Soft PVC Jacket Perfect for In-Wall Installations. 
24K Gold Plated with 99.99% Oxygen Free Copper Conductor (Bare Copper), 
It has an Audio Return Channel (ARC) that combines both the audio and video channel in one cable. 
Fully Shielded with 24K Golden-plated connector provides the unique quality that maintains strength 
Audio Return Channel 
The new specification adds an audio channel that will reduce the number of cables required to deliver audio 'upstream' from a TV to an A/V receiver for processing and playback. In cases where a TV features an internal content source, such as a built-in tuner or DVD player, the Audio Return Channel allows the TV to send audio data upstream to the A/V receiver via the HDMI cable, eliminating the need for an extra cable. 
4K Resolution Support 
The new specification enables HDMI devices to support extremely high HD resolutions, effectively four times the resolution of a 1080p device. Support for 4K allows the HDMI interface to transmit digital content at the same resolution as the state-of-the-art Digital Cinema systems used in many movie theaters. 
HDMI Ethernet Channel 
The HDMI 2.0 specification adds a data channel to the HDMI connection, enabling high-speed, bi-directional communication. Connected devices that include this feature can send and receive data via 100 Mb/sec Ethernet, making them instantly ready for any IP-based application. 
3D Support 
The version of the specification defines common 3D formats and resolutions for HDMI-enabled devices, enabling 3D gaming and other 3D video applications.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: I was at a loss after the remote of my SMART invertor  LG AC died recently. A freelance AC technician who was called, fiddled with the remote for over 45 minutes, contacted a senior and informed me that he would need to take with him the remote along with some sensory circuit part of the AC for testing and mentioned an estimated cost of +3k! productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Great brackett and strong holding power
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I used these brackets to hold my modem, they were easy to work with, simply measure and allow the space you need in between the brackets. I made sure they were going to be level with each other and then peeled the paper off the brackets that revealed the 3m glue. I placed the brackets in place and put pressure on the glue and then allowed the brackets to adhere to the wall. I had read in reviews that one of the complaints of this product was that they did not say in place and the glue failed and they fell off the wall. I allowed the brackets to cure for 2 1/2 days prior to putting my modem on them, the 3m glue that they use needs around 72 hours to fully reach their full holding power. I am very pleased with how they look and they feel and I am confident that they will hold for a very long time. I would buy this product again.

aPlusContent.rawText:
Product Description
LIRAMARK High Quality Nylon Braided Multi-function Fast Charging cable for Android, iOS and Type C devices, 3 in 1 Charging Cable, 3A , ( 3 Feet ) 
LIRAMARK 3-in-1 Charging cable brings in a new, innovative and quality charging experience to the user with the high functionality of charging multiples devices conveniently at the same time while travelling or at home or at the office.
This product is equipped with USB port, iOS cable and type c connector compatible with almost any device and is specifically designed and dedicated for charging.
LIRAMARK is always committed to delivering high-quality products with remarkable features to our customers.
This new multifaceted, portable, and resourceful product brings you a fast, reliable and handy source of lightning fast charging on the go.
This single premium charging cable is uniquely equipped with three connectors which save the user the daily trouble of messed and entangled cables.
The micro USB connects is perfect for charging micro USB device with any USB port and can be used with cell phones, eBooks, digital cameras and so much more.
THREE FAST CHARGING DATA CABLES 
One For all and All in one! That’s what you get with LIRAMARK 3 in one data cables It gives you the freedom of carrying just one cable which you can connect with micro USB, iOS, and Type C. 
REDEFINING PERFORMANCE 
This will be the only cable you may need to buy for years to come to connect flawlessly to almost any device with the nylon braided covering and wide compatibility with quick charge support of 3A. Also, it provides a very convenient way to charge while travelling. 
UNIVERSAL COMPATIBILITY 
LIRAMARK 3-in-1 cables provide universal compatibility with its three interchangeable cables with simultaneous and easily accessible charging. This device is fully efficient to be inter-operable 
with a large number of devices like compatible with Android and iOS Smartphones. Some devices which are compatible are namely, Samsung, HTC, Motorola, Nokia, LG, Sony, PS4, PS Vita, vivo, Oppo, One Plus, Go Pro GPS devices, portable chargers, Bluetooth speakers etc. 
DURABILITY AND COVER PROTECTION 
LIRAMARK 3-in-1 functionality of the cable can help in quickly charging multiple devices from a single port. And it built with nylon braided wire and user friendly design.3 in 1 data cable extra stronger than the normal charging data cables and covered with aluminum foil tinned copper core material. And 10000+ bends for lifespan it has more durability Compare to normal data cables 
PREMIUM MATERIAL AND SAFE CHARGING 
LIRAMARK in 1 charging data Cable product is built with Premium aluminum foil tinned copper core material containing TPE jacket which is not only long lasting, which is suitable for charging multiple devices at the same time and also provides safety and stability to both the source and the connectors by maintaining sustainability. It boasts of enduring strain multiple times more than the ordinary cables

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: This Liramark 3 in 1 Nylon Braided fast charging cable for Type C, Micro USB and iphone for all smartphones in classic blue color is a really beautiful product. I got it the very next day after order, for 224/-.Conclusion: Liramark 3 in 1 is highly recommended, suitable only for phone charging, NOT suitable for power bank charging, although proudly Made In India product, very light weight, soft cable, splendid performance, attractive highly distinguishable attractive blue color, worth the price, much better than all other highly priced similar products, great value for money buy.Here is how it performed and the other products, devices, accessories that I used to test it:::1st TestSamsung Galaxy On Nxt charging with Liramark blue cable:a) from AMYTEL 30000 mAh power bank to Samsung galaxy On Nxt 3300 mAh smart phoneb) used the Micro USB cable from the product under review Liramark blue cablec) charged On Nxt mobile from 87% to 100% from AMYTEL via Liramark blue Micro USB Cabled) it took 38 minutes to do the abovee) it drank up power juice of 2% from the power bank's 89% to 87% to do the abovef) Summary::: Time taken by On Next or this Liramark blue cable for charging this 13% of On Nxt is 38 minutes from 87% of On Nxt to 100% from Amytel Power Bank.One more test as above:::a) AMYTEL 30000 mAh Powerbank to On Next chargingb) used this product "Liramark 3 in 1 Nylon Braided fast charging cable for Type C, Micro USB and iphone for all smartphones in classic blue color" which I got for 224/-c) used Micro USB Type B from Liramark to connect to On Next from Powerbank.d) charged On Next from 67% to 95% from Powerbanke) it took 1 Hour Zero minutes for above jobf) drained powerbank from 99% to 93% for above jobg) Mobile phone screen display does not show Fast Charging. Shows only "charging xx%" as On Next is NOT a fast charging phone at all.2nd TestM20 charging with Liramark blue cable:a) from AMYTEL 30000 mAh power bank to Samsung galaxy M20. This mobile is a 5000 mAh smart phoneb) used the Type C cable from the product under review Liramark blue cablec) charged M20 mobile from 65% to 100% from AMYTEL via Liramark blue Type C Cabled) it took 2H05M to do the abovee) it drank up power juice of 13% from the power bank's 100% to 87% to do the abovef) M20 has a fast charging 15W battery capacityg) Liramark says it is a fast charging cable set of 3 in 1. Samsung Galaxy M20 is also a fast charging smart phone. AMYTEL power bank says it is also a fast charging FC QC quick charging power bank. But during my test here, It was not indicating or showing fast charging FC anywhere at all on my M20 device screen. It was showing just "charging xx%". It obviously is NOT doing FC QC.h) Summary::: Time taken by Samsung Galaxy M20 or this Liramark blue cable for charging this 35% of M20 is 2H05M from 65% to 100% from Amytel Power Bank. At this rate, M20 will take 6H10M to fully charge 5000 mAh from 1% to 99% from the AMYTEL 30000 mAh power bank with the Liramark Type C cable connected. Comparatively, it took only 1H38M to charge my Samsung Galaxy M20 from 63% to 100% with direct connection of M20's own fast charging cable & M20's own adapter which is an Adaptive fast charging wall charger. And, Fast Charging is always displayed on the mobile screen with this method.One more Test as above:::Liramark Blue cable Type C connected to AMYTEL 30000 mAh power bank for Samsung Galaxy M20 charging from power bankA) it took 2H51M to charge M20B) from 52% to 100% of M20C) shows only "charging xx%" & does not show Fast Charging on M20 screenD) although M20, AMYTEL power bank, Liramark 3 in 1 cable all claim to be fast chargersE) drank up power juice from power bank from 94% to 76% for above job3rd TestPower Bank charging with Liramark blue cable:a) AMYTEL 30000 mAh charging (input) with Liramark blue cable, charging the power bank from 87% to 99%b) used Liramark Type C cable to connect to power bankc) I used a Samsung wall charger power output source with capacity 9 volts 1.67 Amps & it supports FC QC with "Adaptive Fast Charging" printed on the Charger. This Adaptive Fast Charging wall charger ships with Samsung Galaxy M20.d) Summary::: Liramark says it is a fast charging cable set of 3 in 1. Samsung wall charger is also a fast charging charger. AMYTEL power bank says it is also a fast charging FC QC quick charging power bank. Despite all this, it took 1H51M to charge from 87% to 99% for just 12% charging of the power bank. It was not indicating or showing fast charging anywhere at all. At this rate, it will take 15 hours to fully charge the AMYTEL 30000 mAh power bank from 0 to 100% by connecting it with this Liramark Type C blue cable. It obviously is NOT doing FC QC in this test, I felt.4) 4th test yet to do: AMYTEL 30000 mAh power bank charging with Liramark Micro USB cable5) 5th test AMYTEL 30000 mAh powerbank charging with Liramark 8 pin iOS iphone cable:::A) AMYTEL power bank input via Liramark blue 8 pin ios Lightning iphone pin Type A male to 8 pin male for power bank charging connected from M20's Adaptive Fast Charging wall charger.B) charged power bank from 70% to 96%C) took 5H18M for this job @ 12.23 minutes per percent charging for just 26% charging in 318 minutes (318 divided by 26)D) can test anybody's patience if you use Liramark 8 pin ios cable to charge this power bank, absolutely painful & maddeningly slow charging Liramark cable, not suitable for power bank charging.6th Test:::a) Samsung Galaxy M20 charging with M20's own Adaptive Fast Charger wall charging plug but with Liramark Type C cableb) used this product "Liramark 3 in 1 Nylon Braided fast charging cable for Type C, Micro USB and iphone for all smartphones in classic blue color".c) used Type C from Liramark to connect to M20d) charged M20 from 70% to 100%e) it took 2 Hours 45 minutes for above jobf) Mobile phone screen display did not show Fast Charging. Shows only "charging xx%" although all accessories used above, are claimed to be Fast Charging.

Since am not sure if this is due to laptop, or from what, and since from wall sockets it charges fine, not taking any star off for this reason yet. Used one of the USB current/voltage meters available on Amazon to verify the charging current.

Product Description
LG Smart TV Remote 
LG TV Remote Control 
Discover a spectrum of LG-compatible TV remote controllers designed to elevate your control experience. From the intuitive functionality of MR20GA and MR21GA Magic Remotes to the standard yet reliable navigation of RM-L1162, RM-L930+3, and RM-L930+, each remote offers distinct features tailored for LG TVs. Embrace the advanced capabilities of AN-MR18BA Magic Remote, designed for specific LG models, or explore the offerings of L1818, ensuring seamless compatibility with a range of LG TVs. With these diverse options, find the perfect remote controller to optimize your interaction and unleash the full potential of your LG TV viewing experience. 
LG Magic Remote 
LG TV Remote 
Experience the epitome of convenience with compatible LG remote controllers, granting you access to apps and voice control at the press of a button. Seamlessly navigate through a world of applications and engage the power of voice commands efficiently with a single click. Whether it's toggling between streaming services, adjusting settings, or activating voice assistant features, these intuitive remotes unify your control interface. Streamline your interaction with your LG TV, bridging the gap between app management and voice-activated functionalities. Simplify your entertainment experience and elevate your control with the harmony of apps and voice control, all within the simplicity of a singular click on your LG remote controller. 
LG Remote For Smart TV 
Compatible LG TV Remote Controller 
The range of available remote controllers is exclusively tailored to seamlessly sync with LG TV systems. Each remote, including MR20GA, MR21GA, RM-L1162, RM-L930+3, RM-L930+, AN-MR18BA, and L1818, is meticulously crafted for precise compatibility with LG TVs. Offering intuitive functionalities and specific features, these controllers are engineered to optimize your LG TV experience. Their design and programming cater solely to LG TV models, ensuring a seamless and responsive interaction. Elevate your control experience and unlock the full potential of your LG TV, knowing that these remotes are purpose-built to harmonize efficiently with your LG entertainment system. 
LG TV Remote MR20GA | MR21GA 
The MR20GA and MR21GA remote controllers stand out as the exclusive models requiring a pairing process for optimal functionality. These advanced LG Magic Remotes offer an array of smart features and intuitive controls, designed specifically for select LG TV models. To maximize their capabilities, a simple and quick pairing procedure ensures seamless synchronization with your LG TV. By following the prescribed pairing instructions, you'll efficiently unlock the full potential of these remotes, enabling precise control and seamless interaction with your LG TV. Enjoy the convenience and innovation of these paired LG Magic Remotes, enhancing your entertainment experience with unparalleled ease and responsiveness. 
LG 4K TV Remote Control 
To ensure a seamless transition and compatibility, it's essential to order our remote controllers only if the keys match precisely with your existing remote controller. We prioritize your convenience and aim to provide a perfect replacement or supplementary controller that mirrors the functions and layout of your current one. This ensures a hassle-free experience, enabling you to seamlessly integrate our remote into your setup. Prioritizing this match assures that our remote will flawlessly sync with your entertainment system, preserving your familiarity with controls while offering enhanced functionalities. Order with confidence, knowing that the keys on our remote precisely align with your existing controller, promising a smooth and uninterrupted transition.

productPageReviews.reviewDescription: Good purchase. Replaced the original and feels the same.

I have two LG window  AC's same model l purchased in a gap of 2 years. (About 15+ years old and still working fine). Unfortunately and unimaginably LG did not put eco mode on panel or the remote of new AC. Accidental discovery for me was that with older AC remote I could run the new AC on ECO mode which means a lot of power and money saving for me. Well the useless remote that came with new AC was never used after the discovery.  It used to rattle also. Later discovered broken PCB inside remote too. LG please note!!! Well so I landed up on Amazon looking for a new remote. After receiving this new remote I tested it and found it runs both my ACs on eco mode. So guys even if you have a working remote with your AC buy and test this remote and you may be happy and lucky to know that your LG AC pcb has eco mode and you can run it on eco mode with this remote. Probably write to LG besides destroying the remote that came with LG (without eco mode). Save national resource of electrical power as well as your hard earned money. Go ahead and buy this remote.
It's a replacement of my LG Window AC. Working just fine. Happy with the performance.

productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: To start with delivery came a day early! I am using this to extend a Dish Joey receiver. productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on 19 February 2023
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewTitle: Works as advertised at a great price!
productPageReviewsFromOtherCountries.reviewDescription: I bought this cable for a Chromebook to hook it to either a large screen TV or computer monitor. After trying it out on both I can say it works as advertised. You get a 1920x1080 60 Hz signal to the display; the display itself can communicate back to the Chromebook to tell it what it is (ie Toshiba TV, etc.)  It has nice molded connectors on both ends and there's enough cable length to position your device an appropriate distance from the display (unless you are using something like a 65"+ display.)I have one small issue with this cable - the quality of the text, especially small text on a larger screen. You might find yourself making adjustments to the display output resolution to make text more readable. While this is primarily a function of the display it is something to keep in mind if you are looking for a large display you can use for text editing.Considering this cable is only $1 more than the Amazon Basics 6' HDMI cable, it's hard to go wrong with this if you need to connect a USB-C device to HDMI.

aPlusContent.title: Product Description
aPlusContent.rawText:
Product Description
FEDUS PRO SERIES 16 AWG OXYGEN FREE COPPER SPEAKER WIRE 
Create a clean, clear connection between speakers and an A/V receiver or amplifier with C&E speaker wire. Made of 99.9% oxygen-free copper (OFC), the high-quality speaker wire provides excellent conductivity for a pure signal to and from audio equipment. The speaker wire reduces distortion and sound impurities, helping to deliver an optimal audio experience. 
OXYGEN FREE COPPER(OFC) - Oxygen Free Copper Wires are 165% more conductive than CCA (Copper Clad Aluminium) Wires and prevent Wires From Oxidation. In Contrast, CCA wires are aluminium wires coated with a thin layer of copper, that erodes due to oxidation resulting in distorted sound. FEDUS Pro series OFC Speaker Cables provide a lifetime of distortion-free sound.
RUGGED PVC JACKET - Allows free, wide and seamless adjustment of the required physical properties of this wire such as flexibility, elasticity, and impact resistance.
EASY POLARITY IDENTIFICATION - This two-color jacket allows for easy polarity identification. Making a polarity mistake could be damaging to your audio equipment.
SOFT TOUCH JACKET - The jacket on our cable is designed with the installer in mind. The flexibility of this jacket allows for easy routing and has a low memory.
VARIABLE LENGTHS AND GAUGES - FEDUS pro series Speaker wires are available in multi lantgh and color, and in 14 or 16 AWG.
FITS - 3.5mm Stereo Minijack Connector, 1/4-inch/6.3mm TRS Plug, RCA Connector (AKA Phono), Banana Plugs, Speaker Pins, MMCX Connector, and more.
COMPATIBLE - With audio components like speakers, A/V receivers, amplifiers & other professional sound applications Installation Intended for custom installs.
UNDISTORTED SOUND SIGNALS - FEDUS speaker cables have a plastic jacket that insulates the copper wiring inside to deliver undistorted signals
LOW-RISK INSTALLATION - Our cable speaker wires offer enough resistance to overheating and electrical flow because of the gauge thickness

SUPERB AUDIO QUALITY 
Enjoy your home theater or cat stereo with clear sounds and deeper bass using FEDUS Pro series Speaker Wires
